# Irvine Unified School District (IUSD)

> > Irvine Unified School District provides student and parent access to educational portals, class schedules, and account management through the Aeries system.

IUSD serves the Irvine community with integrated digital platforms for student information and parent engagement. The district leverages the Aeries student information system as its primary portal for class schedules, grades, and school communications.

## Key Topics

- Aeries
- Student Portal
- Parent Portal
- Class Schedules
- School Login
- Student Information System
- Irvine Unified School District
- IUSD
- Account Access
- School Communications

## Student & Parent Portals

- [Aeries: Portals](https://my.iusd.org): Aeries student and parent portal for IUSD class schedules and account access
